howToPlay: Use your main attack to deal increasing damage as projectiles widen and travel further. Use your Super to mark targets for team support, and rely on gadgets to control space or trap enemies. Keep a safe distance given your 3400 health to effectively manage the battlefield.
gears: Equip DAMAGE to increase output when low on health, SHIELD to boost your survivability, or SPEED to navigate maps faster. GADGET COOLDOWN is also excellent for ensuring you have access to your area control tools more often.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical area control and providing utility to their team.
